rationale.intuition: Verified recruited athlete in D1 sport 是最强 hook。Stanford recruited athletes 大致 ~85-90% accept rate（per SFFA data）。但 profile 还要看运动 fit + 学术过 'admit slot' 门槛。低 GPA (3.7) 在 Stanford 通常被卡，但 athlete slot 让多数运动员避开常规标准。Industry 估计 40-85%。

sources.name: Stanford CDS 2024-25
sources.evidence: Overall admit rate 3.7%; athletic slot system not officially published but inferred high admit rate

sources.name: Arcidiacono SFFA Expert Witness Report 2018
sources.evidence: Recruited athletes admitted at ~88% rate at Harvard; effect at Stanford expected similar magnitude

sources.name: NCAA Recruitment Survey 2024
sources.evidence: Verified D1 recruited athletes at T20 schools see 30-50× lift in admit rate over general applicants
